summary: This clinical trial is testing the study drugs macupatide and eloralintide, either alone or combined, to see how they affect weight reduction in adults. The study focuses on participants who have obesity or are overweight, along with type 2 diabetes. Eli Lilly and Company is sponsoring this Phase 2 trial, which has an enrollment of 200 participants and is currently Active, not recruiting. Participants will receive either the active study drugs or inactive placebo comparison treatments.
